name: Gala Seed
author: prodrive-ac-builder
_about: The real-world seed for the game 1978 (github.com/k10-motorsports/k10-1978). NOT an AC track. The owner's San Diego My Maps KML network (extensive, imperfect - smoothing knobs below), augmented from OSM so Waring Rd, Eldridge, Gala Ave and the residential grid around Gala Ave are always present. Landmarks: the golf course (sanctum), Lake Murray, Benchley-Weinberger, home. Built by scripts/game/build_seed.py, exported by scripts/game/export_seed.py into the game repo's seed/ (contract: k10-1978/PIPELINE_BRIDGE.md).

location._anchor: 5591 Gala Ave - the start anchor (OSM node 596681395)

source._doc: The two Google My Maps 'Directions' exports from the san-diego-cruise project, merged into one deduped road graph (scripts/gps/network.py).

network._doc: Graph knobs (scripts/gps/network.py). smooth_iters is the 'rough edges' dial. osm_augment guarantees owner-required streets even where the KML never traced them: every drivable way within bbox_margin_m of home (the Gala grid) + named roads (regex) across the network extent.

osm_augment._centers_doc: home (the Gala grid) + school (the KML never traced Topaz Lake Ave) + the Del Cerro hill (owner: 'send del cerro up and over the hill to Navajo and the roads it connects to it')

roads.name: College Avenue
roads._doc: Del Cerro Blvd down to Alvarado

roads.name: Alvarado Road
roads._doc: owner: College + Alvarado up to 70th (replaces the phantom creek crossing); grandmother lived on Alvarado

roads.name: Tuxedo Road
roads._doc: the cousins' house is on the 6700 block

route._doc: Anchors for the SPINE - the home->school path Dijkstra'd over the built network (the PCG spine the game grows from). The full network ships in the bundle regardless.

landmarks._doc: OSM areas fetched by stable id, projected into the ENU frame. 'sanctum' = the golf course (the game's hand-authored spiritual anchor - the pipeline provides location/extent only); 'water' = Lake Murray; 'school'/'home' = placement anchors.

cousins_house.label: the cousins' house

church.label: the church
church._doc: Palisades Presbyterian Church (OSM node 358845587), between Waring Rd and Carthage/Birchwood - confirmed by the owner's screenshot
